measuredHead: 8ef91bd13 plus the s204-m01 working tree at the time of the run
why: The mission's premise was that policy #1833 constrains root-core alone and that mcp-server pays ~30 extra minutes for another suite's flake. That is false for mcp-server, and this is the measurement. packages/mcp-server/vitest.config.ts sets fileParallelism:false itself, because its pack specs run prepack builds that replace shared workspace dist trees. Forcing parallelism does not un-serialise a suite that serialises itself for a reason.
verdict: RED and unusable. 462 of the serial 7,263 tests were never even collected, because 80 files failed to run at all. The wall fell 1,420s to 1,001s — a 30% saving for a destroyed run.
